assessment: This article is a carefully done assessment of the role of the moulting hormone ecdysone in coordinating growth and patterning of the wing imaginal disc in the final larval instar of Drosophila with nutritional input. Importantly, the authors find that growth is only partially dependent on the ecdysteroid titre, whereas the onset of bristle patterning is dependent on a threshold level that is different for different genes.
